news_risk: No negative news, regulator press releases or enforcement actions found in the sources reachable during this check. Note: the primary search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable (connection refused) and Bing returned only generic results, so news coverage could not be exhaustively screened. The J&K High Court matters involve a Drug Inspector, i.e. a state drug-regulatory proceeding, but the company appears there as petitioner challenging it; no adverse regulatory finding is documented in the retrieved text.
note: Sanctions: no hit found, but this is NOT a verified negative screen - the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool is a JavaScript application and returned no query results via plain HTTP fetch, and UN/EU/UK/BIS lists could not be queried within the tool budget. Treat sanctions status as 'not checked / unknown', not 'clear'. Court record is substantial (65 hits on Indian Kanoon) and is dominated by IP/commercial litigation where the company is mostly defendant, plus criminal-miscellaneous petitions filed BY the company against drug-authority proceedings in J&K and Rajasthan. Per project rules these are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally. Credit rating: not public / not found - null, not estimated. RF/CIS supply evidence: none found; no export or shipment records to Russia or CIS were located, and no claim of such supplies was seen - null rather than a negative finding, since customs/trade data sources were not reachable. Company appears to be a subsidiary of Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited per the Madras High Court order caption (30.04.2026) - useful for group-level sanctions screening, which was not performed here. Legal identity, HS code and shipment volumes deliberately not researched per role scope.
